ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED(StageName), ISPICKVAL(StageName,'Docs Out - MCA'), CONTAINS(Lender_Account__r.Name, 'National Funding'), DATEVALUE(APPROVAL_DATE__c) >= DATE(2021,06,11), RecordType.Name <> 'Direct MLP', OR( AND( BOFI_Restricted_State__c = 'Restricted', OR( RecordType.Name = 'FRPSA', RecordType.Name = 'Broker FRPSA' ) ), AND( BOFI_Restricted_State__c = 'Allowed', RecordType.Name <> 'FRPSA', RecordType.Name <> 'Broker FRPSA' ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: This deal does not have the appropriate record type to proceed. If this is a FRPSA state ensure the Record Type is either FRPSA or Broker FRPSA. If it is not a FRPSA state ensure the Record Type is either Broker or Working Capital.
